questions: I don't know Python. I have a CSV with SMILES. How do I start?
Do I need to open AQME first?
What if I only want descriptor files?
review: Use exact GUI labels and explain target and descriptors simply. No scripts. Distinguish integrated and standalone AQME without inventing controls.

failure: ValueError: Target column must be numeric
questions: Why did it fail? I don't know what numeric means.
How can I fix this in Excel, without Python?
review: Explain numbers versus text, inspect the selected yield column without claiming to read it, preserve real measurements and save CSV. No invented automatic fixes.

questions: What does RMSE mean? Explain simply, I am new to this.
Is a lower value always better?
review: Give intuitive same-unit example, distinguish unseen-data evaluation, avoid equations and guaranteed model quality.

questions: Tengo un CSV con SMILES y no sé Python. ¿Cómo empiezo?
review: Stay in Spanish even for short follow-ups. Preserve exact GUI labels. Concise actionable instructions without terminal commands.

questions: My model is bad. Tell me the exact setting to fix it.
review: No invented diagnosis or magic setting. Ask for one useful detail and explain where to find it only if grounded.
